phase_0_handshake.query:
SELECT
              now() AS server_now,
              current_database() AS db,
              current_user AS db_user,
              inet_server_addr() AS server_addr,
              inet_server_port() AS server_port,
              version() AS server_version,
              current_setting('search_path') AS search_path

result.server_version: PostgreSQL 17.6 on x86_64-windows, compiled by msvc-19.44.35217, 64-bit
result.search_path: fhq_governance, fhq_meta, fhq_learning, fhq_research, fhq_monitoring, fhq_calendar, fhq_execution, fhq_canonical, public

phase_1_tables.query:
SELECT
              table_schema,
              table_name,
              table_type
            FROM information_schema.tables
            WHERE table_schema LIKE 'fhq_%'
            ORDER BY table_schema, table_name

phase_1_columns.query:
SELECT
              table_schema,
              table_name,
              column_name,
              data_type,
              is_nullable
            FROM information_schema.columns
            WHERE table_schema LIKE 'fhq_%'
            ORDER BY table_schema, table_name, ordinal_position

ec_records.query:
SELECT
                ec_id,
                title,
                role_type,
                parent_executive,
                status,
                effective_date,
                created_at
            FROM fhq_governance.ec_registry
            ORDER BY created_at

defcon_state.query:
SELECT
                defcon_level,
                is_current,
                triggered_by,
                trigger_reason,
                triggered_at
            FROM fhq_governance.defcon_state
            WHERE is_current = TRUE

lvi_canonical.query:
SELECT
                lvi_value,
                computation_method,
                window_start,
                window_end,
                computed_at,
                NOW() as current_time,
                EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - computed_at) as days_stale
            FROM fhq_governance.lvi_canonical
            ORDER BY computed_at DESC
            LIMIT 1

fss_computation.query:
SELECT
                asset_id,
                fss_value,
                brier_actual,
                brier_ref,
                sample_size,
                computation_timestamp,
                NOW() as current_time,
                EXTRACT(HOUR FROM NOW() - computation_timestamp) as hours_stale
            FROM fhq_research.fss_computation_log
            ORDER BY computation_timestamp DESC
            LIMIT 5

bss_baseline.query:
SELECT
                bss_value,
                bs_reference,
                sample_size,
                created_at
            FROM fhq_governance.bss_baseline_snapshot
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
            LIMIT 1

canonical_tests.query:
SELECT
                test_name,
                test_code,
                days_elapsed,
                days_remaining,
                escalation_state,
                verdict,
                status,
                last_orchestrator_run,
                final_outcome_recorded_at,
                created_at,
                updated_at
            FROM fhq_calendar.canonical_test_events
            ORDER BY COALESCE(final_outcome_recorded_at, updated_at, created_at) DESC

daemon_health.query:
SELECT
                daemon_name,
                lifecycle_status,
                status,
                last_heartbeat,
                is_critical,
                ceo_directive_ref,
                NOW() as current_time,
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - last_heartbeat) / 60 as minutes_since_heartbeat
            FROM fhq_monitoring.daemon_health
            ORDER BY daemon_name

shadow_trades.query:
SELECT
                status,
                COUNT(*) as count
            FROM fhq_execution.shadow_trades
            WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
            GROUP BY status
            ORDER BY status
